title: DiagnosticResult
description: Envelope for any diagnostic module output. The body inside `payload` is module-specific and identified by `schema`.

schema.description: Module-specific result schema identifier with version suffix.

serverName.description: Target server the diagnostic was executed against.

generatedAt.description: Time the diagnostic output was produced (ISO 8601 UTC).

durationMs.description: Total wall-clock duration of the diagnostic run in milliseconds.

inferredSeverity.description: Severity inferred by the module from the data. May differ from the monitoring platform's reported severity.

summary.description: Short, single-paragraph human-readable summary for UI display.

truncated.description: True if the diagnostic was cut off by timeout or output size limit. Consumers should treat payload as partial.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues encountered while running (e.g., one folder access denied during enumeration).

payload.description: Module-specific structured data. Shape determined by the schema field.
